title: Uniform intrinsic exceptional bounds at the specified compactification
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, a separated finite-type $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ and a compactification $c$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use the full finite-Tor categories, intrinsic intervals and intrinsic Tor-amplitude predicates [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-constructible-intervals, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], and the specified intrinsic exceptional functor $H_c$ [def-sf-finite-operation-realizations]. There are integers $c_-,c_+$ independent of the positive coefficient stage $(E,n)$ such that $H_c$ sends every object of $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A_{E,n})$ to $D^b_{ctf}(X,A_{E,n})$, carries intrinsic constructible interval $[a,b]$ into $[a+c_-,b+c_+]$, and carries Tor interval $[a,b]$ into $[a+c_-,b+c_+]$. The interval and Tor clauses are independent implications, and the constructible interval clause allows unordered endpoints. Neither scheme is required separated over $k$. This asserts only preservation by an already defined ambient functor, with no adjunction or compact-support statement.

source.place: Propositions 2.29(2), 3.16(2); blueprint cor-pur-general-admissibility-datum; original exceptional construction step 3.

proof.text: Apply the existing ProEtale.exists_preservationClauses theorem, which already assembles the finite affine charts in cor-pur-general-admissibility-datum and transports the resulting etale bounds to the fixed-module pro-etale category. Choose one natural-number bound for the target dimension and the chart dimension furnished there, before introducing the finite coefficient extension and level. The constants are -2D and 2dY+1, also when the source is empty. The coefficient exponent is invertible by the coefficient_invertible lemma of PurityAffineChartBounds.

Use rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunctionOfCompactification and uniqueness of right adjoints to identify the upstream global etale exceptional functor with the right adjoint at the specified compactification. Whisker with the etale/pro-etale comparison functors.

The exact coefficient realization preserves and reflects boundedness and cohomological concentration. The finite-ring constructible-derived-origin comparison identifies intrinsic constructible homology with the fixed-module constructible predicate. Transport Tor amplitude through intrinsic_hasProEtaleTorAmplitude_iff_torAmplitudeIn, and transport all predicates through the counit and exceptional-functor isomorphisms. Intrinsic bounded constructibility is closed under isomorphisms.

Apply the transported Tor estimate to any finite Tor interval of the input, obtaining constructibility and a finite Tor interval for the output. Apply the upstream cohomological estimate separately for arbitrary endpoints: no order is required by that theorem. Normalize a-2D and b+2dY+1 to additions of the chosen constants. The Tor output endpoints remain ordered because both dimensions are nonnegative.

lean.statement:
theorem sfFiniteOperations_intrinsicExceptionalBounds (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) :
    ∃ cMinus cPlus : ℤ, ∀ (E : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.FieldStage.{u} l)
      (n : ℕ+),
      (∀ L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos Y,
        finiteTorConstructible l E.carrier n n.pos X
          ((sfFiniteOperationsIntrinsicRight l E n c).obj L.obj)) ∧
      (∀ (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos Y) (a b : ℤ),
        constructibleInterval l E.carrier n n.pos Y a b L.obj →
        constructibleInterval l E.carrier n n.pos X (a + cMinus) (b + cPlus)
          ((sfFiniteOperationsIntrinsicRight l E n c).obj L.obj)) ∧
      (∀ (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory l E.carrier n n.pos Y) (a b : ℤ),
        HasProEtaleTorAmplitude Y (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E.carrier n) L.obj a b →
        HasProEtaleTorAmplitude X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E.carrier n)
          ((sfFiniteOperationsIntrinsicRight l E n c).obj L.obj) (a + cMinus) (b + cPlus))
